name: instaglamour-erp
description: Single-service build: the backend serves the built frontend (see README, Deploy to Railway).

scripts.build: npm run build:install && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:install: npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build:frontend: VITE_USE_MOCKS=false VITE_DEV_LOGIN=false npm run build --prefix frontend
